QuestInfo.name: The Frozen Golems
QuestInfo.1: It seems that parts of the Mixed Golem Rubble you brought last time were frozen. Bruce wants you to find out if there are any Frozen Mixed Golems in the Golem's Temple. If there are, #beliminate 30 of them#k and collect #b15 Frozen Stones#k.
QuestInfo.2: It seems that parts of the Mixed Golem Rubble you brought last time were frozen. Bruce wants you to find out if there are any Frozen Mixed Golems in the Golem's Temple.

0.0: There were some frozen parts in those Mixed Golem Rubbles you brought me. That's weird isn't it? It's not that cold around the temple. It could mean that a new type of golem has appeared! So go eliminate 30 of them and bring me 15 Frozen Stones! That'll show them for trying to exist!

yes.0: If a new form of golem has created itself, you should be the FIRST one to smash it into bits! It's the natural order of things!

no.0: But, there is science to be done! I knew I should have given this job to that evil robot lady.

1.0: Did you bring the Frozen Stones? Amazing! The golems are evolving!\r\n

yes.0: This is going to make me famous!

item.0: If a new form of golem has created itself, you should be the FIRST one to smash it into bits! It's the natural order of things! Go out there, beat up 30 of those pesky Frozen Golems and bring back 15 Frozen Stones. That will really give our research the evidence it needs!
